goal: In eight weeks, Foothills Quarter Horses will have a half-day horsemanship experience for up to six guests listed, priced at $145 per person and open for booking. The experience will run every Saturday morning from late May through September, with the first paying departure on Saturday, May 22, 2027. By the end of June, the ranch will have welcomed at least 12 paying guests and established a repeatable booking and operations workflow.

weeks.title: Week 1: Know Your Guest
actions: Write your ideal guest persona
Identify who this experience is not for
Review two or three comparable experiences in the region for price and positioning
checklist: Guest persona document is complete and saved
"Not for" statement is written
Notes on comparable experiences are captured

weeks.title: Week 2: Map the Experience
actions: Outline the beginning, middle, and end of the experience
Define what is included and what is not
Draft three versions of your one-sentence description and test your favourite
checklist: Experience arc fits on one page, with timing for each segment
Inclusions and exclusions list is finalised
One sentence is tested, selected and saved for your listing

weeks.title: Week 3: Cost It
actions: List your fixed costs per departure
Calculate your time cost
Add a margin for unexpected costs
checklist: Fixed costs are documented with dollar amounts
Labour cost per departure is calculated
Total cost per departure, with margin, is entered in the pricing calculator

weeks.title: Week 4: Set Your Price
actions: Calculate your break-even point
Set your final per-guest price
Decide on a minimum booking policy
checklist: Break-even price per guest is calculated
Final price of $145 per guest is confirmed against break-even
Minimum booking policy is documented

weeks.title: Week 5: Insurance, Safety and Policies
actions: Contact your insurance broker about commercial liability
Check permit and licence requirements with the MD of Pincher Creek
Write your safety protocol and guest waiver
Draft your cancellation and weather policy
checklist: Insurance broker has confirmed coverage and sent a certificate
Business licence requirements are confirmed
Safety protocol is written and the waiver is reviewed by your broker
Cancellation and weather policy is written

weeks.title: Week 6: Platform and Listing
actions: Evaluate booking platform options
Create your platform account and complete your host profile
Write your listing headline
Write the full listing description
checklist: Platform decision is made and the account is created
Headline is under 60 characters
Full description is written and read by someone outside the ranch

weeks.title: Week 7: Photos and Availability
actions: Set your availability and pricing in the platform
Plan and shoot your listing photos
Upload photos and finalise the listing
checklist: Saturday departures from May 22 through September are set at $145 per guest
8 to 12 photos are selected, edited and uploaded
Listing is previewed on a phone and reads correctly

weeks.title: Week 8: Go Live
actions: Work through the last open items on your Bookability Checklist
Publish and share your listing
Follow up with interested guests and confirm your first booking
checklist: Listing is live and the shareable link works
Listing has been shared by email, on social media and with local tourism contacts
At least one booking is confirmed for May 22
